blind.table_distance_name: interior wall section with open window
blind.description: A classic modular interior wall section featuring a central open rectangular window. The bottom section consists of wood wainscoting with three recessed/raised rectangular panels. Flanking the framed window opening are two vertical wallpapered panels with olive green floral/foliage patterns. The window has a projecting sill and frame, with two open shutter/casement panels swinging open toward the back. The top of the wall is finished with an overhanging crown molding cornice. Surfaces are solid, clean, and fully textured in cream/tan wood and green patterned paper.
blind.from_above: A long, thin tan rectangle representing the top molding, with a small sill protrusion in front and two angled shutter flaps protruding backward.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1.25 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 7 ft tall) and roughly 4.5 to 5 ft wide.
